description: This file defines the CampaignTracker class, a model representing campaign tracking data within a SugarCRM / SuiteCRM system. It includes properties corresponding to database fields, methods for saving data with URL correction, and functions to retrieve related campaign information and URL assembly for tracking purposes.

classes.name: CampaignTracker
classes.description: A model class extending SugarBean to manage campaign tracking data, including properties for campaign-related fields, and methods for saving, obtaining summaries, and filling in additional details.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overrides the parent save method to ensure the tracker URL has a proper scheme (http/https/ftp) before saving.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns a string summary of the tracker, typically the tracker name.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates related campaign info, message URL, and other details based on current properties and system settings.
